english_classification.chapter_title: Concerning the Sect of the Basket
english_classification.chapter_note: Chapter has a clear two-part structure: (1) paragraphs 1-4 are a narrative encounter with a presbyter from a non-Manichaean sect, entirely institutional/editorial/exhortatory material including polemic and a beatitude identification of 'basket' with 'holy church'; (2) paragraphs 5-6 contain heavily fragmentary but recognizable cosmological teaching — cosmic architecture (pillars, disk, sea), cosmic beings (Mind, Youth, Porter, five sons of the Man, Adamant of Light), and cosmic enumerations (thirty-six, twenty-two, twelve, seven, four). The substrate is NOT dominant — it survives only in the latter, very damaged portion. Teaching purity is low (0.254). The editorial fatigue pattern is inverted here — substrate increases in the second half (+5.39), suggesting the cosmological teaching was appended or preserved at the end while the first half was fully replaced by narrative polemic. Gardner's uncertainty about the chapter's coherence is justified — the connection between the sect discussion and the cosmological catalogue is unclear.

discordance_flags: DIALECT FLAG: Sub-Achmimic ratio is only 0.49 — substantial Sahidic intrusion suggests later editorial hand
